Jab 1.notes: Transitions to Jab 2 as early as frame 13

Jab 2.notes: Transitions to Rapid jab as early as frame 22

Down Tilt.notes: Clanks with projectiles doing less than 26.8% damage.

Forward Smash.notes: This attack hits directly above Dedede only on frame 40. Hammer comes down on 43. Shockwave on 44. Charge hold is frame 33. Multiple hitboxes: an aerial only hitbox that does 0%, sweetspot near tip of hammer, weak hit near Dedede.

Neutral B (Inhale).notes: Startup and total frames refer to minimum usage. 19 endlag after extended usage. Can inhale projectiles starting on frame 14 and involuntarily spit them back. Gains invulnerability for 14 frames after the 4th frame of inhaling a character/item out. For example, if a character gets grabbed as soon as inhale comes out, (f14) the i-frames would be 18-32. Invulnerability information from @Landslide___ on Twitter.

Up B (Super Dedede Jump).notes: Cancelling incurs 30 frames landing lag. Invulnerable on frame 18-21. Super Armor (infinite %) on frames 22-34 and then 69-76. Leg intangibility frame 69-landing. Landing hitbox on frame 3—4. Stars on frame 5—24. Hitbox 69—landing.

Down B (Jet Hammer, Partial Charge).notes: 10 startup from release. 17 to enter charge state. 136 frames to reach full charge. Heavy armor (14%) on frame 1-14 from release but only on ground version.
